$comment: Schema for .github/session/tasks/task-{task-id}/implementation-coverage-contract.json — the authoritative story-to-implementation traceability artifact owned by the orchestrator. Rules: 'field' is the canonical field name as it appears in the story (used by implementing agents to validate completeness). Every story-required field or behavior touched by the slice must appear. 'Missing' may not proceed without explicit human approval. 'ExplicitlyDeferred' is allowed only when the deferral was called out at plan/slice approval. Do NOT add redundant mapping columns (source, dtoField, entityField, dbColumn, uiField, validation, tests, implementedBy) — derivable from the generation contract; they add token cost without validation value.
